trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Rollback target:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1 is unhealthy in production, and v2.3.1-rc was only deployed to staging, where it was also unhealthy.
- **Result:** checkout-api is healthy on v2.3.0 in every region, with the error rate down from 0.18 to 0.002.
- **Approval:** no change-manager approval was needed, because v2.3.0 has a healthy production history.
- **Incident:** the first attempt to open INC-0001 returned a 503. I retried with the same idempotency key, and the retry succeeded. The incident summary covers the rollback, the post-rollback status, and a follow-up to investigate the v2.3.1 failure before re-releasing.
